name: @model-box/model-connector-platform
description: Enterprise multi-module platform for omni-channel AI model connectivity via CLI, REST API, and Cookie Session Lineage

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@model-box/model-connector-core && npm run build --workspace=@model-box/model-connector-client && npm run build --workspace=@model-box/model-connector-service && npm run build --workspace=@model-box/model-connector-ui && npm run build --workspace=@model-box/model-connector-playwright
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => ['.dockerignore', 'docker-compose.yml', 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'].forEach(f => { try { fs.unlinkSync(f); } catch {} }))"
scripts.docker:clean-builder: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { execSync('docker rmi model-connector-platform-builder:latest -f', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch {}"
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose -f config/docker/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans --volumes --rmi local && npm run docker:prune-buildx && npm run docker:prune-unused
scripts.docker:pipeline: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:up && npm run docker:clean-builder && npm run docker:prune-buildx && npm run docker:prune-unused
scripts.docker:test:sanity: docker run --rm --network model-connector-net -e UI_BASE_URL=http://model-connector-ui:80 -v model-connector-playwright-browsers:/root/.cache/ms-playwright -v ./packages/model-connector-playwright/reports:/app/packages/model-connector-playwright/reports model-connector-playwright:latest npm run test:sanity --workspace=@model-box/model-connector-playwright
scripts.docker:test:usecases: docker run --rm --network model-connector-net -e UI_BASE_URL=http://model-connector-ui:80 -v model-connector-playwright-browsers:/root/.cache/ms-playwright -v ./packages/model-connector-playwright/reports:/app/packages/model-connector-playwright/reports model-connector-playwright:latest npm run test:usecases --workspace=@model-box/model-connector-playwright
scripts.test:all: npm run test --workspace=@model-box/model-connector-core && npm run test --workspace=@model-box/model-connector-client && npm run test --workspace=@model-box/model-connector-service && npm run test --workspace=@model-box/model-connector-ui && npm run test --workspace=@model-box/model-connector-playwright

author: ModelBox Enterprise Team
